test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CAP’ is coded as '262413' and 'LOG' is coded as '171022'. How will 'BED' be coded in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**First & third alphabets are coded as the positional value of opposite +2. **

**Second alphabet is coded as **the positional value of** opposite -2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10177bfa9681b6e75868a2d4216e5ba517061b8636d4d0738db1f2e5c0cd608e.png] 

and 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad3507eff7ac68f1458afe6cd498b162d4161e043947bbec55c4b1dd8f4d816.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dcdfa4ad972d1b6e864d35fe83b7c6da32166382f98d4be336432010521a762.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
